entities.summary: Latvia as a major Eastern Front battlefield, the formation of the Latvian Rifle battalions (strēlnieki) fighting for Russia, the German occupation of Courland (1915) and then all of Latvia (1918), and the People's Council's declaration of independence (18 November 1918).
